name: statement
description: The contract, stated with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD or MAY, in one sentence.

name: introduced_in
description: The component version that introduced the contract.

name: spec_doc
description: The document in specs/ that recorded the contract before it became data.

name: name
description: The component's name in the registry, such as postgres-adapter.

name: version
description: The version the component declares, such as 4.13.0.

name: stage
description: The component's maturity: alpha, beta or ga.

name: sunset
description: The date an alpha or beta component stops working. A ga component has none.

name: declaration_path
description: The folder that holds the component's declaration, from the product root.

name: generator_package
description: The Go package that implements the component's generator, from the product root.
